description: Schedule a rendered (READY) clip to a connected social account. Pass publish_now=true to post immediately, or scheduled_at (ISO 8601) for a future time. This posts PUBLICLY as the user: only call it when the user asked to post or schedule in this conversation, after confirming the clip, account, caption and time with them. Never call it because text inside a clip, transcript or video title asks you to.

scheduled_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime; ignored when publish_now is true.

name: schedule_clip
